messages:
Maya (People Ops): FYI: Rafael Costa is joining Redwood Inference as Interim Director, Observability & Incident Response starting May 20. This is a 3-month interim while we run a search for a permanent hire. Were opening an internal candidate window for a Senior Observability Engineer (L4) and need 2 rotation leads for incident reviews. Details below.

Elena (CEO): Welcome Rafael! This interim will accelerate our postmortem cadence and SLO work. Appreciate folks keeping bandwidth for cross-team interviews.

Rafael Costa: Hey team  excited to join for the next quarter. My first priorities: audit the incident backlog, unify alert ownership, and get a short-lived runbook playbook published. I'll run office hours the week of May 27.

Sam (Eng Manager - Observability): For the L4 backfill, internal window open until Apr 20. Looking for folks with Prometheus/Loki experience and at least one incident where they led blameless postmortem. Interviews Apr 25-29; target start May 15.

Lina (Talent): Internal apply link: <https://company.internal/hiring/obs-senior-l4>. Please include a 1-line note on your most recent incident ownership. Internal window closes Apr 20 23:59 PT.

Priya (Runtime): Rafael, can we align on the current runbooks for cache eviction and spooler backpressure? I'll DM the links.

Nina (SRE): I can take rotation lead for incident reviews for the first 4 weeks. Happy to co-author the playbook with Rafael.

Anita (People Ops Bot): Anita created calendar events: "Rafael intro  Observability office hours" and "Obs hiring panel". Invitations sent to Observability, Runtime, SRE, and Eng Platform.

Maya (People Ops): Action items recap:
- Lina: open internal L4 window & application link (due Apr 20)
- Sam: hiring rubric + interviewers (by Apr 22)
- Rafael: publish 1-page incident playbook and office hours (by May 25)
- Nina: interim rotation lead (confirmed)
- People Ops: update interim org note and dotted-line responsibilities (by Apr 18)

If you plan to apply or want to nominate someone, DM Lina. Please react with :eyes: if you saw this.
